raw_content:
rules:
- id: "vuln-openslides-auth-service-70c1aa9f"
pattern: |
  (
    thisUser?.password || dummyPassword
  )
  .isExisting()
  .isPasswordCorrect(password, $PASSWORD)
pattern-not: |
  thisUser.password
  .isExisting()
  .isPasswordCorrect(password, $PASSWORD)
languages: ["typescript"]
message: |
  This code is vulnerable to a timing attack because it uses the `||` operator to determine whether `thisUser.password` is defined or not. If an attacker can control the value of `password`, they can use this information to infer the value of `thisUser.password`. This allows them to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to sensitive data.
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  source-url: github.com/OpenSlides/openslides-auth-service/commit/70c1aa9f5e1db59ec120ecce98d1c1169350a4ee
  category: security
  cwe: CWE-200
  owasp: A3
  references:
    - https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Timing_Attack
    - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/200.html
    - https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authentication_Cheat_Sheet.html#password-based-authentication

-        if (!thisUser.isExisting() || !passwordCorrect) {
+        const passwordCorrect = await this.isPasswordCorrect(password, thisUser.password || dummyPassword);
+        if (!thisUser.password || !thisUser.isExisting() || !passwordCorrect) {
